_readme: Every material input for the Joby FCFF/WACC valuation. Units: USD millions unless a key says otherwise; shares in millions; rates are decimals. 'src' points to data/source_ledger.csv. 'label' is History (reported fact), Market (observed price/rate), or Judgment (analyst assumption).
decision_user: Buy-side investment committee with no current JOBY position

share_price.label: Market
share_price.note: Sept. 1, 2026 close, as recorded in Lab 08 (commit a6e9520).

risk_free_rate.label: Market
risk_free_rate.note: 4.20% risk-free rate used by Joby in its June 30, 2026 warrant valuation (10-Q Note 3).

beta.label: Judgment
beta.note: Pre-commercial, high-volatility aerospace; tested 1.4-2.2 in sensitivity.

pretax_cost_of_debt.label: Judgment
pretax_cost_of_debt.note: Straight-debt yield for an unrated, loss-making issuer; the 0.75% coupon reflects the conversion option, not the cost of debt.

opening_balance_sheet._src: S4 — 10-Q condensed consolidated balance sheet, June 30, 2026 (p. 3)

share_count._src: S4 — 10-Q cover page (Aug. 3, 2026) and antidilution table (June 30, 2026)
share_count.options_note: Weighted-average strike not extracted; all options counted as if exercised at zero strike (maximum dilution, ~0.5% of shares).
share_count.warrant_note: Warrants are deducted at their $21.5M reported fair value rather than added as shares, to avoid double counting.
share_count.earnout_note: Sponsor earnout shares are legally outstanding and already in the basic count; the earnout liability is therefore not also deducted.

h1_2026_actual._src: S4 — 10-Q statements of operations and cash flows, six months ended June 30, 2026

tax.nol_note: Post-2017 federal NOLs offset at most 80% of taxable income. FY2026 losses are added to the pool.

operating_plan._note: Calendar-year drivers. 2026 is the full fiscal year; the model removes H1 2026 actuals to get the July-December stub. Fleet, utilization, and price are Judgment anchored to S5/S7 production and launch statements.
operating_plan.label: Judgment

convergence._note: 2032-2040: rule-based fade from the 2031 explicit year to a steady state, run through the same integrated statement engine. R&D grows 2%/yr and SG&A grows at half the revenue growth rate (fixed-cost leverage), each floored at a steady-state share of revenue; gross margin converges over four years; growth capex = revenue increase / sales-to-capital.
convergence.label: Judgment

other_drivers.depreciation_src: S3/S4 — FY2025 D&A $40.2M on opening PP&E $121.0M (33%); H1 2026 annualized $45.7M on $146.6M (31%). 20% used because new fleet assets have longer lives (Judgment).

terminal.label: Judgment
terminal.note: 3% nominal growth is below a defensible long-run U.S. nominal GDP growth rate (~4%). Terminal reinvestment = g / RONIC.
